title: Zara's World
overview: Zara's World is a complex story with a simple heart about the people who shape the world of eighteen month old baby Zara. Her two high profile mothers are sporting legend Zoe Goss and dance performer Claudia Alessi, who live in Perth. Her biological father is Kirk Page, also a high profile performer who lives in Sydney but has an active role as Zara's father. When they are not able to all be together, Kirk connects via Skype to stay in touch. As they juggle their busy careers and navigate traditional expectations of what it means to be a family, the joys and challenges of being one of three parents to a curious and delightful child are revealed in this uniquely compelling documentary.
